why: A frame whose callback throws is never reported, so the one frame that failed disappears from the measurement. Since issue #736 the same `finally` also leaves the scheduler's in-callback state, so the mutation additionally reports the next start of the loop as continuing the run.
killedBy: instrumentRaf: times the callback without changing it reports a frame whose callback throws, and still throws
instrumentRaf: times the callback without changing it does not mark the next start continued after a callback threw (issue #736)
